settings.seo_description: Find our café and roastery at the Khlong Rang Shell station on Route 304 in Si Maha Phot, Prachinburi. Stop for an espresso, pour-over or matcha, try our baking, or pick up beans for home.

home.hero_title:
Coffee roasted
in Si Maha Phot
home.hero_text: Find us at the Khlong Rang Shell station on Route 304 in Prachinburi. Stop for a coffee at the bar or pick up a bag of beans to brew at home.
home.hero_alt: The two-storey Brewtanist café with a wooden balcony and a coffee bar visible through the ground-floor windows
home.story_text:
We love coffee and plants, so we put “brew” and “botanist” together to name the café.

We choose our beans, roast them and try different brews until we find a cup we like. If you’re unsure what to order, tell the barista what you usually drink or which flavours you’d like to try.
home.story_alt: The coffee bar and espresso machine inside Brewtanist
home.visit_text: Park at the Shell station and walk over. There’s seating on both floors and Wi-Fi if you want to get some work done. You can pick up beans at the bar before you leave.
home.visit_alt: The front of Brewtanist café at the Khlong Rang Shell station

coffee.title: At the coffee bar
coffee.description: Do you like a bold espresso, coffee with milk, or something fruity? Tell the barista and we’ll help you choose beans for your cup.

cards.label: Espresso
cards.title: Our house blends
cards.text: Choose from Mr. Plantman, Mr. Ozmo and Ms. Lazybug. Each blend has its own roast level and flavour profile.
cards.alt: Coffee grinders and Brewtanist house blends at the bar

cards.label: Filter coffee
cards.title: Single origin
cards.text: We rotate the beans on our pour-over menu. Ask at the bar which origins we’re brewing today.

cards.label: Beyond coffee
cards.title: Matcha and baking
cards.text: Pair a matcha with one of our house-baked scones, croissants or cakes. The selection changes from day to day.
cards.alt: Drinks and baked goods at Brewtanist

products.title: Our house blends
products.description: We serve three espresso blends at the bar, from rich chocolate to sweet vanilla and bright floral and fruit notes.
products.note: Alongside our house blends, we sell single-origin beans, drip bags and capsules. See what’s available on Shopee or ask at the café.

items.name: Mr. Plantman
items.description: Bold flavours of dark chocolate, caramel and nuts. Enjoy it black or with milk.
items.alt: 3D illustration of the Brewtanist Mr. Plantman coffee bag

items.name: Mr. Ozmo

items.alt: 3D illustration of the Brewtanist Mr. Ozmo coffee bag

items.name: Ms. Lazybug

items.alt: 3D illustration of the Brewtanist Ms. Lazybug coffee bag

products.finder_text: Answer three questions about the coffee you drink to find a blend to try.

roastery.title: In our roastery
roastery.description: We roast the house blends and single origins that we serve at the bar and sell by the bag. Then we taste each one and adjust the brew recipe to suit the beans.

steps.title: Choosing the beans
steps.text: We start with beans that have flavours we’d like to explore, then work out how best to brew them.

steps.title: Roasting
steps.text: We taste for sweetness, acidity, aroma and body, and use what we find to adjust the roast.

steps.title: Test brewing
steps.text: We taste and fine-tune the brew recipe before serving the coffee at the bar.

items.question: Is there parking?
items.answer: Yes. Park at the Khlong Rang Shell station and walk over to the café.

items.question: What coffee can I take home?
items.answer: We sell house blends, single-origin beans, drip bags and capsules. Ask at the bar what’s available today.

items.question: Can I try single-origin coffee?
items.answer: Yes. We rotate the single origins on our pour-over menu. For espresso, you can also choose from the beans listed at the bar.

items.question: Do you serve matcha and baked goods?
items.answer: Yes. We serve matcha and bake in-house. The selection of baked goods can vary each day.
